articles.title: 2 pilots killed in LaGuardia Airport runway collision identified
articles.summary: Two young, ambitious Canadian pilots tragically died in a runway collision at New York's LaGuardia Airport on Sunday. Both individuals were at the very start of their careers, having dedicated years to pursuing their dream of flying. Their untimely deaths mark a poignant loss within the aviation community, underscoring the inherent dangers in this demanding profession.

articles.title: US server maker Super Micro is eyeing India manufacturing unit
articles.summary: Super Micro Computer is actively exploring establishing a server manufacturing unit in India. This strategic move would significantly bolster India's electronics manufacturing capabilities and align with the 'Make in India' initiative. The company is currently engaged in discussions with various state governments, signaling a substantial investment that could create jobs and strengthen the nation's digital infrastructure and technological self-reliance.

articles.title: Lagos sets up LOC for National Intermediate Games
articles.summary: Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu has approved the inauguration of the Local Organising Committee (LOC) for the National Intermediate Games. Lagos is set to host the maiden edition of this national sporting event. This crucial step underscores Nigeria's commitment to youth development and national sports excellence. The LOC will oversee all preparations, aiming to ensure seamless planning and execution, foster talent discovery, and promote healthy competition across the country, thereby strengthening national unity.

articles.title: edgefirst-hal 0.12.0
articles.summary: A required website component encountered loading issues, potentially due to browser extensions, network problems, or specific settings. Users are advised to troubleshoot by verifying connections, disabling ad blockers, or trying an alternative browser. This incident highlights the need for robust digital infrastructure and user proficiency in managing technical glitches, essential skills for future leaders.

articles.title: Who profits from a world at war? Inside the global boom in arms transfers
articles.summary: As of March 2026, the global security landscape is increasingly volatile due to heightened, interconnected conflicts across multiple regions. Major escalations involve a war with the US and Israel, indicating widespread instability. This complex geopolitical environment demands strategic awareness from SSB aspirants to understand the evolving challenges facing international peace and security.
